newsitem.title: USA: Bucyrus to be acquired for $186.3 million.
newsitem.headline: Bucyrus to be acquired for $186.3 million.

text.p: Bucyrus International Inc., a mining equipment manufacturer, said Thursday it has agreed to be acquired for $18 a share by American Industrial Partners Capital Fund II LP or one of its affiliates in a deal valued at about $186.3 million.
American Industrial Partners is a private investment partnership which makes equity investments in public and privately held companies.
The deal is worth about $186.3 million, based on Bucyrus' 10.35 million shares outstanding.
The deal is subject to the execution of a definitive agreement, financing, and approval by Bucyrus' board, shareholders and regulators.
Bucyrus said it does not expect the deal to affect its previously announced acquisition of Marion Power Shovel Co. from Global Industrial Technologies Inc. for an undisclosed amount.
Bucyrus, based in South Milwaukee, Wis., manufactures large-scale surface mining equipment and provides parts and services.
Bucyrus' stock rose $3.125 to $16.625 on Nasdaq in afternoon trading.
